# Get the bzip2 file ready.
base64 bzip2.base64 test.bz2

mito -use file,mime src.cel
! stderr .
cmp stdout want.txt

-- src.cel --
[
	string(file('test.bz2', 'application/x-bzip2')),      // Extract directly.
	string(file('test.bz2').mime('application/x-bzip2')), // Extract from buffered bytes.
]
-- bzip2.base64 --

-- want.txt --
[
	"hello bz\n",
	"hello bz\n"
]
